subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Reconhecer a variação linguística como manifestação de formas de pensar e expressar o mundo.

components.description_pt: Identificar exemplos de variação linguística como expressões de diferentes visões de mundo culturais
components.description_en: Identify examples of linguistic variation as expressions of different cultural worldviews
components.cc_component_description: Identify examples of dialects or registers used by characters in stories, dramas, or poems

components.description_pt: Reconhecer que diferentes variedades de idioma refletem formas distintas de pensar e expressar o mundo
components.description_en: Recognize that different varieties of a language reflect distinct ways of thinking and expressing the world
components.cc_component_description: Compare how two varieties of English convey different meanings or tones in a literary text

components.description_pt: Analisar como variação linguística manifesta diferenças em perspectiva e expressão cultural
components.description_en: Analyze how linguistic variation manifests differences in cultural perspective and expression
components.cc_component_description: Compare the cultural perspective in a non-U.S. literary work to a familiar viewpoint

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast the varieties of English (e.g., dialects, registers) used in stories, dramas, or poems.
Analyze a particular point of view or cultural experience reflected in a work of literature from outside the United States, drawing on a wide reading of world literature.
